manifest: shared parameter manifest for roadmap items B and E
status: locked for the conventions recovered from code; three decisions remain open (see decisions_required)
authority: Values marked source=code are the convention IN FORCE, recovered from the committed sources and cross-checked by tests/test_manifest_BE.py. Values marked source=proposed appear in no committed script or output and are card proposals only.

stacks.note: The repository runs three disjoint time conventions, not one. The manifest keeps them separate; conflating them is the single most likely way B and E silently diverge.
stacks.shot: Sequential detection and policies. Dimensionless tau_c/c in cycles; no absolute c. Used by B.
stacks.physical: tau-optimised map. c = tau + t_dead with t_dead = 1 as the unit of time. Used by C08.
stacks.identifiability: sid_run7. Prices NO dead time: td = 1.0 is assigned at sid_run7.py:20 and never used in any equation. Its axis is tau_c/T2. Used by E.

operating_point_second.warning: appears in no committed script and no archived output

action_set.note: theta only; tau is NOT an action. p0(pi/2) = 0.5 exactly for any C_bar; p0(pi) = (1-C_bar)/2, which is 0.30 at the pilot and 0.10 at C_bar=0.8.

false_alarm_target_secondary.note: h = ln(gamma), set analytically; live in sid_core/sid_run5, NOT the policy stack

calibration.method: fixed-iteration bisection on h, no convergence test
calibration.h_star_lattice: h* in {1 + 5k/64 : k odd, 1 <= k <= 63}; adjacent reachable values differ by 5/32 = 0.15625

bank.prior: discretised stationary N(0, s^2), renormalised on the grid
bank.why: g, prior and T all depend on s; e1 depends on C and s. Every Bank is operating-point dependent.

hedges.conflict: cards/v2.0-seed.md:20 and ledgers/roadmap.yaml say three hedges; four are calibrated and measured. note-03a-errata E2 names three schedule FAMILIES (interleave B=1, B=10, explore-then-switch), which reconciles the count only if switch@300 and switch@1000 are one family.

benchmark.definition: bench(T) = min(delay[oracle-mid(tc=T)], delay[extremum-only]) at each true tau_c

acceptance.note: sid_fig_policy_delays.py:50 hard-codes _target, _tol = 3.0e4, 0.30 and only WARNS; it is not a gate and it passes rows whose true ARLs are +49% and +58% off.

t_dead.warning: c = tau + t_dead is defined ONLY in code (sid_core.py:331, sid_run3.py:129, sid_run4.py:59). The frozen card never defines it.

u.consequence: rho_1 = F(u) * exp(-c/tau_c), so the AR(1) reduction is exact only as tau/tau_c -> 0 (short interrogation relative to the correlation time), NOT as c/tau_c -> 0.

eta_0.conflict: cards/v2.0-seed.md:26 (item E) asks for TWO calibration uncertainties; three are already run and archived in res7A. E's wording is behind the archive, not ahead of it.

C_bar_0.note: zero-tau contrast; 0.8 is not on this grid

dimensionless_target.ratio_2: Delta_Gamma_phi / (2 eta_0 Gamma_hat), stored as res7A column 8, range 0.0625 ... 31.25
dimensionless_target.note: Both ratios are ALREADY computable from committed code. Item E's dimensionless restatement needs no new machinery, which is why it runs first.

admissible_classes.A: |chi(tau) - chi_hat(tau)| <= eta_0 * chi_hat(tau) for all tau in T (pointwise band)

determinism.status: UNVERIFIED — class B is a numerical L-BFGS-B infimum, which is deterministic in seed but optimiser-dependent; a third stack reproduced it to 6.0e-8 against SCHEMA.md:43's stated 6.0e-8 tolerance. E is reproducible, not bitwise-deterministic across stacks.

must_not_reuse.C17: oracle-mid(tc=20) h*=4.359 (ARL 33852+-3394) and learner-interleave-B10(bank) — calibration rows withdrawn as unreproducible
must_not_reuse.C18: every delay measured on the withdrawn thresholds, including bench(20) = 1332.19 +- 114.43
must_not_reuse.consequence: Every tau_c/c = 20 baseline in analysis/outputs/res6_policies.json is poisoned. B must recalibrate at tau_c/c = 20 from scratch and may not compare against the archived row.

hazards: analysis/lib/sid_policies.py holds C and s as MUTABLE MODULE GLOBALS with three inconsistent readers. Adding a second operating point by reassigning them will silently mis-build any Bank constructed before the reassignment. This is the highest-risk item in the manifest.

delta(0) = 2*sum r_k at (C_bar=0.8, s=0.3) is 0.0613, 0.4757, 2.0544 at tau_c/c = 1, 5, 20, against C23's declared validity level 0.3. Two of the three proposed grid points lie OUTSIDE leading-order mid-fringe validity. The exact comparator is unaffected; only leading-order statements are.
I_mid_lo omits the factor e^{-2 s^2} that C02's statement says the leading-order rate carries. See note 13.

decisions_required.question: Is the proposed C_bar = 0.8 the effective contrast C_bar(tau) used by the shot stack, or the zero-tau contrast C_bar_0 used by the physical maps?
decisions_required.why_it_matters: The two differ by exp(-tau/T2). Nothing in the card or code states which is meant.

decisions_required.question: C_bar = 0.8 exceeds the parity ceiling. cards/v1.1-frozen.md:117 caps C_bar_par = (1/2) C_bar_1 C_bar_2 <= 1/2, :132 states that effective contrasts above 1/2 require the FULL FOUR-OUTCOME likelihood with residual oscillator noise, and :134 makes C_bar <= 1/2 versus C_bar > 1/2 the principal figure's distinction. cards/v2.0-seed.md:11 then decided the paper's principal claims live in the parity regime C_bar <= 1/2, with C_eff(kappa) an appendix. Should the freeze-gating second point sit in the appendix regime?
decisions_required.why_it_matters: As specified, B makes a freeze gate depend on roadmap D (four-outcome likelihood), which is currently non-gating and scheduled after the freeze.

decisions_required.question: Item E asks for two calibration uncertainties; eta_0 = {0.02, 0.05, 0.10} are already archived. Keep three, or is a specific pair intended?
decisions_required.why_it_matters: Cheap either way, but the card wording should match what is run.
decisions_required.blocks: E wording only, not the run
